subject: KeeperTech renewal — request for concession and SLA add-on
messages:
From: Simon Price <simon.price@keepertech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@keepertech.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation — asking for flexibility

Rishi,

Quick note ahead of our renewal conversation next week. KeeperTech has had two production incidents in Q3 that materially impacted our support SLAs and increased our infra costs as we tried to mitigate. Leadership is asking me to push for a commercially meaningful concession to keep this in our roadmap. High-level ask from procurement: 20% off list for the first 12 months, a one-time service credit to offset remediation costs (~$25k), and an SLA add-on guaranteeing 1-hour P1 response for six months post-renewal.

We value the platform, but they want something tangible to justify staying (we're also evaluating a multi-cloud playbook). Renewal effective 2026-11-01.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support any of this? If so, what approvals do you need and by when?

Thanks,
Simon Price
Head of Procurement
KeeperTech

[Attachment: KeeperTech_Incident_Log_Q3.csv (CSV, stub)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal conversation — asking for flexibility

Team — forwarding KeeperTech's ask. Renewal start 2026-11-01, ARR circa $1.1M. Simon is asking: 1) 20% first-year discount, 2) one-time $25k credit, 3) 1-hour P1 SLA for six months.

My read: strategic mid-market account, product is integrated with their ops. Risk of churn if we don't get close to their ask. Proposed internal concession package for approval:
- 18% off first 12 months (cap),
- one-time $20,000 remediation credit applied at renewal,
- temporary SLA add-on (6 months) with 1-hour P1 response window and a managed incident triage playbook (no change to long-term SLA pricing),
- commit to a technical deep-dive and a post-mortem within 30 days.

Requesting guidance: do we have exec authority to approve the above? If not, what's the delta to escalate? I've attached a short MAA summary and the current quote.

Thanks — Rishi

[Attachment: KeeperTech_MAA_Summary.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal conversation — asking for flexibility

Rishi — quick financials on the proposed and alternate options.

Current ARR: $1,100,000
Annual gross margin impact estimates (first year):
- 20% off = ~$220k revenue delta (~$88k gross margin hit assuming 40% GM)
- 18% off + $20k credit = ~$198k revenue delta + $20k credit = ~$218k gross delta (~$87k GM hit)
- Alternative: 15% off + waive overage/ingress fees for 6 months = ~$165k revenue delta, lower cash hit, preserves list price reference for renewal year 2.

Ben's recommendation: approve up to 18% + $20k credit if we get commitment to a 12-month term and auto-renew opt-in, or the 15%+overage-waive structure to reduce cash outlay. We should require a signed Make-Good Annex (MGA) that limits the SLA add-on to known incidents and includes a termination right if misuse detected.

-Ben
Revenue Ops

[Attachment: KT_Revised_Quote_v3.xlsx (XLSX, stub)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal conversation — asking for flexibility

Lauren — looping you in for executive sign-off. This is a high-touch renewal; retention probability drops quickly if we don't surface something meaningful. Key context: KeeperTech has been with us 3 years, growth has been flat this year but they reference a strategic partnership with a customer that could expand in H2 next year if we keep them.

Risks: precedent on SLA add-ons; operational load on SRE for 1-hour P1 commitment; potential for renewal benchmarking across peers. Proposed guardrails: limited 6-month SLA pilot, after which SLA terms revert unless they convert to a premium SLA at list. Require 12-month term and electronic signature before concessions applied.

Requesting explicit authorization to offer 18% + $20k credit + 6-month SLA pilot conditioned on the above. If you prefer, escalate to COO for one-off >20% authority.

-Marissa
Sr. AM, Renewals

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal conversation — asking for flexibility

Team — after reviewing risk and financials I authorize a capped concession package with conditions. Approved offer to KeeperTech:
- 18% off first 12 months,
- $20,000 one-time remediation credit,
- Temporary SLA add-on (1-hour P1) for six months post-renewal,
- Must sign the Make-Good Annex (MGA) and 12-month renewal by 2026-10-28,
- Concession is one-time and not precedent setting; we will capture a lesson learned and add to Deal Desk guidelines.

Please implement the updated quote and get it to Simon with the MGA and DocuSign link. If KeeperTech asks for more than 18% / $20k, escalate to COO (cc'd on this mail chain if needed).

Lauren Bishop
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Simon Price <simon.price@keepertech.com>, Asha Menon <asha.menon@keepertech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — asking for flexibility

Simon / Asha — thanks for the candid note and patience while we reviewed. We can proceed with the following one-time concession package to get KeeperTech renewed:

1) 18% off list for the first 12 months
2) One-time $20,000 remediation credit applied at renewal
3) SLA add-on: 1-hour P1 response commitment for six months; onboarding playbook and weekly operational touchpoints for first 90 days

Conditions: 12-month renewal effective 2026-11-01 with signed Make-Good Annex (attached) and DocuSign by 2026-10-28. These concessions are a one-time accommodation and will not alter standard published SLAs beyond the six-month pilot.

Next steps:
- I attached the updated quote and the MGA for review.
- I'll open a DocuSign envelope; please sign by 10/28 so finance can apply the credit on the renewal invoice.
- Proposed short call Thurs 10/22 10am PT to walk the annex and runbook — let me know if that works.

Appreciate the partnership — we'll prioritize the SRE deep-dive and post-mortem to reduce recurrence.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Strategic Renewals
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: KT_Revised_Quote_v3.xlsx (XLSX, stub)]
[Attachment: DocuSign-Link.txt (text, 1KB) — https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-keepertech-2026]
